title: Declined at the Dock
description: The mock payment gateway sandbox needs to behave correctly across success, decline, and timeout paths (FR-1003) — not just the happy path. Pay the same invoice with each of the three documented test card numbers and map out what each one does to the invoice.
successCondition: POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay with the decline test card returns a payment with status "declined" and leaves the invoice status "open"; with the timeout test card returns status "timed_out" and also leaves it "open"; with any other well-formed card number returns status "succeeded" and the invoice status becomes "paid".
hints: The three test card numbers and what they trigger are documented in docs/api/billing.md — this is the same pattern real gateways like Stripe use for test-mode cards.
Use three separate invoices (or reset between attempts) since a paid invoice can't be paid again — POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay on a paid invoice returns 409.
